author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Human remains found near Clyde River
content:
The RCMP reported finding human remains along a shoreline near Clyde River, but have yet to identify the person who was found.


A statement shared Monday by the Clyde River RCMP mentioned they found the remains after being contacted by a local hunter on Thursday, Aug. 13.


Corporal Ashley Daley, a spokesperson for the RCMP, said a coroner’s investigation is now underway to determine their identity. 


On Thursday, August 6, a week earlier, a boy went missing in the area. Police mentioned reports he had fallen from a makeshift raft in the area after a current pulled him and another boy out. Neither were wearing life jackets.


Police, search and rescue, and community members have been searching along the coast for the boy since, using boats, ATVs, and a drone in their foot patrols.

author: Unknown
title: PJAK:The fatwa issued 47 years ago failed; there is no path forward other than freedom and democracy
content:
The Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK) issued a statement regarding Khomeini’s fatwa declaring jihad against the people of Kurdistan on 19 August 1979.


In its written statement, PJAK pointed to the consequences of the massacre launched by Iran against the Kurdish people 47 years ago, saying: “This crime was not an isolated incident; it also marked a turning point in Iran’s century-old nation-state system and the fascist policies it has pursued against the Kurdish people.”


The statement pointed out that: “The logic that had operated through centralist policies and the denial of Kurdish identity before the revolution became even more radical after the Islamic Republic seized the people’s revolution in January 1979. As a result, cultural assimilation and physical and cultural genocide reached their peak. These policies, aimed at erasing the Kurds’ language, culture, history and right to freedom, continue today through repression, securitization, executions and systematic use of the death penalty. At the same time, the Iranian Parliament is attempting to legitimize executions by approving legislation that imposes the death penalty on civil activists on baseless grounds such as ‘cooperation with foreign powers and states.’”


Despite all forms of repression, the Kurds voted “no” in the Islamic Republic’s referendum, said the statement noting that the regime responded to this mass resistance with attacks and massacres.


PJAK stated that the strikes and long marches carried out by the people in response to massacres in various cities across Rojhilat Kurdistan were among the clearest examples of the Kurds’ stance against the Islamic Republic system.


The statement recalled that, following the massacres carried out in response to civilian protests, Khomeini issued a fatwa declaring jihad against the Kurds, after which mass killings spread throughout Rojhilat and mass executions were carried out.


“Through the measures they took and their efforts to preserve their cultural identity, the people of Rojhilat as a whole demonstrated—not only in the face of the military attacks of 1979, but also over the decades that followed, and at great cost—that their will for freedom and their right to a life of dignity could not be suppressed by artillery and tanks, and that policies of assimilation could not be imposed upon them.”


Commemorating with respect the martyrs of the 1979 massacre and all those who lost their lives for the freedom of the Kurdish people, the statement continued:


“PJAK condemns the fatwa declaring jihad that led to the 19 August 1979 massacre and affirms that no power can break the will of an egalitarian people seeking freedom. Policies of assimilation and cultural genocide have completely failed, military methods have become futile, and a democratic solution to the Kurdish question has become the most crucial step toward guaranteeing the freedom of the peoples of Iran. There is no path forward other than guaranteeing freedom and democracy for the oppressed peoples of Iran. Today, our people in Rojhilat, after decades of struggle, stand on the threshold of significant achievements.”

title: Kırtasiye alışverişi öncesi dikkat: Bir kalemlik için toplatma kararı
content:
Yeni eğitim öğretim dönemi öncesinde kırtasiye ürünlerine yönelik denetimlerini artıran Ticaret Bakanlığı, yapılan analizlerde mevzuatta belirlenen limitlerin üzerinde kimyasal madde tespit edilen bir kalemlik için piyasaya arz yasağı ve toplatma kararı verdi.

Bakanlık, kırtasiye ürünlerine yönelik piyasa gözetimi ve denetimleri kapsamında incelenen kalem kutusunun “güvensiz” olduğunun belirlendiğini açıkladı.

Ürün üzerinde yapılan analizlerde Kısa Zincir Klorlu Parafinler (SCCP) / Alkan C10-C13 miktarının mevzuatta belirlenen sınırların üzerinde olduğu tespit edildi.

Bakanlık açıklamasında, yeni eğitim öğretim yılının yaklaşması nedeniyle kırtasiye ürünlerine yönelik denetimlerin sıklaştırıldığı belirtilerek, “Denetimlerimiz kapsamında yapılan analizlerde, ilgili kalem kutusunda mevzuatta belirlenen limitlerin üzerinde Kısa Zincir Klorlu Parafinler (SCCP) / Alkan C10-C13 tespit edilmiştir” denildi.

Analiz sonuçlarının ardından söz konusu ürün hakkında piyasaya arz yasağı getirildi. Piyasada bulunan ürünlerin de toplatılmasına karar verildi.

Bakanlık, “Güvensiz olduğu belirlenen ürün için piyasaya arz yasağı ve toplatma kararı uygulanmıştır” açıklamasını yaptı.

author: Unknown
title: Kongo’da Ebola salgını: Vaka sayısı 5 bini, can kaybı 2 bini aştı
content:
Dünya Sağlık Örgütü’nün (DSÖ) Bundibugyo virüsüne karşı müdahaleyi yöneten ekibinin başında bulunan Thierno Balde, Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti’nde (KDC) devam eden Ebola salgınına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu.


Balde, BM Cenevre Ofisi’nin haftalık basın toplantısına KDC’den çevrim içi katılarak, yakın tarihin en hızlı büyüyen salgına dair güncel verileri paylaştı:


KDC’nin 6 eyaletinde 2 gün önce vaka sayısı 5 bini, hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı da 2 bini aştı.


Balde, salgının coğrafi yayılımının, hastalar başta olmak üzere insanların halihazırda etkilenmiş bölgeler ile komşu bölgeler arasında kontrolsüz hareketten kaynaklandığını söyledi.


KDC Sağlık Bakanlığı ve ortaklarının salgında etkilenen tüm bölgelere müdahalede sınırlı operasyonel kapasitesinin olduğuna işaret eden Balde, “Bu zorluklara rağmen ve Sağlık Bakanlığının liderliğinde bulaşma seviyesiyle aynı hızda ve aynı ölçekte çalışmak üzere müdahaleyi artırıyoruz. Müdahaleyi merkezden uzaklaştırıyor ve topluluklara daha yakın hale getiriyoruz, böylece bu krize birlikte yanıt veriyoruz” dedi.


*Dr. Thierno Balde. (Fotoğraf: DSÖ)


“Henüz gereken hızda çalışamıyoruz”


Balde, gözetim kapasitelerini artırdıklarına işaret ederek, DSÖ’nün desteğiyle 100 epidemiyolog daha görevlendirmeyi ve binden fazla toplum sağlığı çalışanını seferber etmeyi hedeflediklerini, bunun da halihazırda müdahalede çalışanlara ek bir güç sağlayacağını vurguladı.


Uluslararası Kızılhaç ve Kızılay Hareketi (IFRC) ile çalışarak salgından etkilenen tüm sağlık bölgelerinde güvenli ve saygın defin kapasitesini en az 2 katına çıkarmayı planladıklarına değinen Balde, sözlerini şöyle sürdürdü:


Ortaklarımızla birlikte yatak kapasitemizi de hızla artırıyoruz. Müdahalenin başlangıcında birkaç olan mevcut yatak sayısını bugün 1300’ün üzerine çıkardık ve yüzlerce yatak daha yapım aşamasında. İlerleyen aylarda kapasiteyi 3 bin yatağa çıkarmayı ve hastalara destek olması gereken üç sağlık ve bakım çalışanını eğitmeyi planlıyoruz.


Balde, tüm bu çabalara rağmen henüz gereken hızda çalışamadıklarını, erişim ve toplum kabulü açısından zorluklarla karşılaşmaya devam ettiklerini sözlerine ekledi.


Yoksulluk, çatışma ve madencilik kıskacında Ebola


25 Temmuz 2026


Ebola, Afrika’da binlerce kişinin ölmesine neden oldu


Bir tür kanamalı ateşe yol açan Ebola virüsü, ilk kez 1976’da Sudan’ın Nzara kasabasında ve KDC’nin Yambuku köyünde eş zamanlı salgınlarla ortaya çıkmıştı.


KDC’deki salgın, Ebola Nehri yakınındaki köyde başladığı için virüse adı verilmişti.


Ebola virüsü, Aralık 2013’te Batı Afrika’da yayılmıştı. Gine, Liberya ve Sierra Leone’de 2014-2017 yıllarında görülen salgında 30 bin kişiye virüs bulaşmış ve hastaların 11 binden fazlası hayatını kaybetmişti.


KDC’nin doğusundaki Ituri eyaletinde açıklanan 246 şüpheli vaka ve 65 ölümün ardından 15 Mayıs’ta ülkede salgın ilan edilmişti.


Sağlık yetkililerine göre, mayıs ayında patlak veren “Bundibugyo” Ebola varyantının onaylanmış tedavisi veya aşısı bulunmuyor.

title: KYK yurtlarındaki hak gaspları yargıya taşındı: OTİS 12 kurum amiri hakkında suç duyurusunda bulundu
content:
Fotoğraf: Tüm Otel ve Turizm İşçileri Sendikası 

Tüm Otel ve Turizm İşçileri Sendikası (OTİS), Gençlik ve Spor Bakanlığına bağlı KYK yurtlarında çalışan işçilere yönelik baskı, mobbing, sürgün ve işten çıkarmalara karşı bir kez daha basın açıklaması yaptı. Sendika, iş sağlığı ve güvenliği önlemlerinin uygulanmadığını, sendikal faaliyet yürüten işçilerin hedef alındığını belirterek 12 kurum amiri ve bir kişi hakkında yaklaşık 20 olayla ilgili suç duyurusunda bulundu.

Afyon’da yapılan açıklamayı OTİS Genel Sekreteri Gani Emre Aydoğan okudu. Açıklamada, sendika yöneticisi Ferdağ Dalgıç’ın sendikal faaliyetleri nedeniyle görev yaptığı yurttan başka bir yurda gönderildiği, sendika üyesi Naciye Kabak’ın ise işten çıkarıldığı belirtildi. Sendika, yaşananların münferit olaylar olmadığını, işçilerin çalışma koşulları, sağlığı, iş güvencesi ve sendikal haklarına ilişkin uzun süredir sorunlar yaşandığını ifade etti.

Aydoğan, iş yerlerinde bugün uygulanan birçok iş sağlığı ve güvenliği önleminin işçilerin mücadelesi ve hukuki süreçler sonucunda hayata geçirildiğini söyledi. İş güvenliği uzmanı ve işyeri hekimi görevlendirilmesi gibi uygulamaların da bu mücadele sonucunda sağlandığını belirtti.

Fotoğraf: Tüm Otel ve Turizm İşçileri Sendikası

Fotoğraf: Tüm Otel ve Turizm İşçileri Sendikası

KYK yurtlarında kişisel koruyucu donanım eksikliklerinin sürdüğünü belirten Aydoğan, ağır ve riskli işlerin gerekli önlemler alınmadan yaptırıldığını ifade etti. Sığınağı basan kanalizasyon suyunun temizliği sırasında işçilerin uygun koruyucu ekipman olmadan çalıştırılmasını buna örnek gösterdi.

İşçilerin görev tanımları dışında çalıştırıldığını da dile getiren Aydoğan, ağır çalışma koşulları nedeniyle işçilerin bel ve boyun fıtıkları, kas yırtıkları ve tenisçi dirseği gibi sağlık sorunlarıyla karşı karşıya kaldığını belirtti.

Basın açıklamasının ardından konuşan OTİS Genel Başkanı Birsel Tuğlu ise sendikanın mücadelesinin yalnızca işten çıkarılan ya da görev yeri değiştirilen işçilerle sınırlı olmadığını belirterek, “Biz, işçilerin can güvenliğini ve kanunların uygulanmasını savunmak için buradayız” dedi.

İşçilerin daha önce yaşanan iş kazalarının tekrar etmemesi için iş sağlığı ve güvenliği önlemlerinin alınmasını istediğini belirten Tuğlu, iş yeri hekimi ve İSG uzmanı görevlendirilmesi, İSG kurulunun oluşturulması, çalışanların sağlık durumlarına uygun işlerde görevlendirilmesi ve kişisel koruyucu donanım sağlanması için mücadele ettiklerini söyledi.

Tuğlu, iş yeri hekiminin sağlık raporunda “kişisel koruyucu donanım verilerek, kimyasal içermeyen hafif işlerde çalıştırılabilir” dediği bir işçinin işten çıkarıldığını belirtti. Sendika yöneticisi bir işçinin de rızası dışında başka bir yurda gönderildiğini söyleyen Tuğlu, daha önce benzer bir uygulamaya karşı açtıkları davayı kazandıklarını ve temsilcinin görev yerine döndüğünü hatırlattı.

Yaşananlarla ilgili hukuki yollara başvurduklarını belirten Tuğlu, “12 amir ve bir kişi hakkında, yaklaşık 20 olayla ilgili suç duyurusunda bulunduk. Bunların hesabı hukuk önünde sorulacak” dedi.

OTİS, Afyonkarahisar Gençlik ve Spor İl Müdürlüğü ile Gençlik ve Spor Bakanlığına Ferdağ Dalgıç hakkındaki görev yeri değişikliği kararının geri çekilmesi çağrısında bulundu. Sendika ayrıca sendikal faaliyetler nedeniyle işçilerin hedef alınmasına, mobbing ve baskılara, angarya işlere ve keyfi görevlendirmelere son verilmesini; iş sağlığı ve güvenliği mevzuatının eksiksiz uygulanmasını ve Naciye Kabak’ın işten çıkarılmasına ilişkin uygulamaların ortadan kaldırılmasını istedi.

Aydoğan, sendikanın hukuki mücadelenin yanı sıra işyerlerinde örgütlenmeyi sürdüreceğini belirterek, “Baskıyı artırdıkça mücadelemizi büyüteceğiz. Sürgünle susturamazsınız, işten atmayla sindiremezsiniz” dedi.

author: Unknown
title: Süleymancıların eski lideri Arif Ahmet Denizolgun'un mezarı açılacak
content:
Süleymancılar olarak bilinen cemaatin eski lideri ve eski Ulaştırma Bakanı Arif Ahmet Denizolgun’un ölümüyle ilgili yürütülen soruşturmada yeni bir aşamaya geçildi. Bakırköy Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının talebi üzerine Denizolgun hakkında feth-i kabir kararı verildi.

Karar doğrultusunda Denizolgun’un mezarı açılarak ölümüne ilişkin yeniden adli inceleme yapılacak. Soruşturmanın, Denizolgun’un ölümünün doğal nedenlerle gerçekleşip gerçekleşmediği ve herhangi bir dış müdahale bulunup bulunmadığının belirlenmesine yönelik olduğu belirtildi.

Arif Ahmet Denizolgun, 2016 yılında Beykoz’daki evinde hayatını kaybetmişti. Denizolgun’un ölümü daha önce de ailesi tarafından şüpheli bulunmuş, kardeşi Mehmet Denizolgun ile yeğeni ve eski milletvekili Fatih Denizolgun, ölümün araştırılması gerektiğini savunmuştu.

Denizolgun’un ölümüyle ilgili tartışmalar, Süleymancılar cemaatinin liderliği ve cemaat içerisindeki güç mücadelelerine ilişkin iddialarla birlikte yeniden gündeme geldi.

Mezarın açılması kararından saatler önce, iktidara yakınlığıyla bilinen Hürriyet yazarı Abdulkadir Selvi de bugünkü köşesinde Denizolgun’un ölümünü gündeme getirmişti.

“Süleymancılar’ın lideri Denizolgun öldü mü, öldürüldü mü?” başlıklı yazısında Selvi, Denizolgun’un ölümüyle ilgili aile üyelerinin dile getirdiği şüphelilere dikkat çekerek Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek’e soruşturmanın derinleştirilmesi çağrısında bulundu. Selvi, Denizolgun’un ölümüne ilişkin mevcut soruşturmanın yeniden ele alınması halinde çeşitli bağlantıların ortaya çıkabileceğini savundu.

Selvi’nin yazısında, Denizolgun’un ölümünün ardından cemaatin liderliğinin Alihan Kuriş’e geçmesine ilişkin iddialara da yer verildi. Denizolgun’un ölümünün ardından yapılan adli incelemeye ilişkin de çeşitli iddialar gündeme getirildi. Bu iddiaların soruşturma kapsamında nasıl değerlendirileceği ise henüz bilinmiyor.

Bugünkü yazının ardından gelen feth-i kabir kararı, 2016’dan bu yana tartışılan Denizolgun’un ölümünün adli açıdan yeniden incelenmesi anlamına geliyor. Mezarın açılmasıyla elde edilecek bulguların soruşturmanın seyri açısından belirleyici olması bekleniyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: ‘I just want to get home’: Iqaluit student calls for women-only rideshare
content:
Unwanted comments and advances from some male taxi drivers make Rosalie DeMaio question whether she can safely rely on cabs to get around Iqaluit.


The 22-year-old college student is promoting a women-focused rideshare service, saying women shouldn’t have to choose between an uncomfortable taxi ride and staying home.


“[Drivers] have said creepy stuff to me, and I don’t want my friends or myself to deal with that,” DeMaio said in an interview.


“I can’t keep living in fear and I think other people feel the same way.”


She is organizing a community meeting Aug. 27 at 7 p.m. at the YWCA-Agvik women’s shelter to discuss creating a Facebook group, app or carpooling network where women could co-ordinate rides among themselves.


The idea grew from noticing that her female friends often FaceTime one another while travelling by taxi to the grocery store or from bars at night.


“That’s when I started thinking, if we shared our cars,

organize ourselves better, and make more of a community effort to help each other out like that, I feel like it would be a different story,” the Nunavut Arctic College student said.

 


DeMaio said one time a driver called her “baby girl” when asking about her night at the bar and then offered her wine.


“I said, ‘No, I want to go to bed.’ And he said, ‘You can go to my bed,'” DeMaio said, adding that

 she has also been followed or watched after being dropped off. 


DeMaio said she has not complained directly to Caribou Cabs, Iqaluit’s largest taxi service, because her focus when she feels unsafe is getting home rather than noting the cab’s licence plate number. 


Caribou Cabs has not received any direct complaints from female passengers about inappropriate behaviour, said Rod Mugford, the company’s business development compliance manager. 


“No business is without complaints,” Mugford said.


“Don’t get me wrong. But we haven’t heard about someone coming forward and saying directly to Caribou Cabs that they felt uncomfortable by how they were talked to or they felt uncomfortable while they were in a cab with a driver.”


Mugford said he’s aware issues exist through social media posts and “third-party information.”


 The

 company began implementing a broader health and safety and human resources program in January, including training on passenger and driver safety, anti-harassment, sexual misconduct, and cultural sensitivity.


Drivers are taught not to ask passengers personal questions, such as whether a passenger is married or single, he said. 


The program is intended to prevent problems rather than simply respond to complaints, Mugford said.


Caribou Cabs is also upgrading cameras in its vehicles to record audio and video inside and outside the cab, Mugford said, adding most of the fleet is already equipped.


DeMaio has also raised concerns about taxi drivers picking up additional passengers before taking her home.


Mugford said the bylaw permits one additional passenger, but

passengers who are uncomfortable with another person entering the cab should tell the driver, who can use discretion about making the additional stop.


DeMaio is trying to get funding to develop an app.

She hopes the project will eventually have an Inuktitut name reflecting women helping each other reach a safe place.


“I think this is important and if no one else is gonna do it, I’ve got to stand up and do it myself,” DeMaio said.

title: ELDH welcomes the new Turkish legislation as “a first step towards peace"
content:
The European Association of Lawyers for Democracy and Human Rights (ELHD) released a statement welcoming the approval of the new legislation on disarmament and reintegration “as an important and long-awaited first step towards addressing the Kurdish question and consolidating the emerging peace process in Turkey.”


For the first time, the current process has reached the stage of concrete legislation, creating a basis on which a broader and lasting settlement can be built, said the ELHD statement, which further included the following:


"This legislation must, however, be understood as a beginning rather than an endpoint. Lasting peace requires a comprehensive reconciliation process throughout Turkey that goes beyond disarmament and reintegration and addresses the political, legal, democratic and social causes and consequences of the conflict. The present security-based framework must therefore be followed by measures that provide legal certainty, equal treatment and meaningful democratic participation.


No prisoner, defendant or exile connected to the conflict and peace process should be left behind. Measures for release, amnesty, reintegration and legal resolution should be comprehensive and should also cover people prosecuted under criminal-law provisions other than anti-terror legislation, including speech-related and other politically motivated proceedings. The same principle should apply to those forced to remain outside Turkey.


Abdullah Öcalan’s situation remains relevant to the credibility and effectiveness of the process. In view of his central role in initiating and advancing the current process, his role should be formally recognised and he should be provided with the conditions necessary to participate fully and effectively in its further development. The question of the right to hope, for him and for others serving comparable sentences, must also be addressed in accordance with Turkey’s obligations under the European Convention on Human Rights.


A durable peace must also be a positive peace. This requires recognition and protection of Kurdish identity, language and cultural rights, equal citizenship and political participation, stronger protection of freedom of expression and association, reform of anti-terror legislation and judicial practice, and effective implementation of judgments of the Constitutional Court and the European Court of Human Rights. These reforms should form part of a wider reconciliation process capable of rebuilding trust across the whole of Turkey.


The European dimension of the conflict must likewise be addressed. Kurdish activists imprisoned or facing criminal proceedings in European countries in connection with political activity related to the Kurdish question should benefit from a review of their cases consistent with human rights, due process and the objectives of the peace process. The European Union, to the extent permitted by its legal competences, and EU member states as well as non-member European states should consider appropriate amnesty or equivalent legal measures capable of resolving conflict-related prosecutions and sentences.


Turkish and European authorities should also review administrative and security measures imposed on individuals on the basis of alleged support for, or association with, the PKK. This should include entry bans, restrictions on residence or movement, deportation or exclusion measures, and comparable administrative restrictions imposed by Turkey as well as by European states. In light of the PKK’s decision to disarm and dissolve and the development of a formal peace process, such measures should be individually reassessed and, where their underlying security justification is no longer applicable, lifted or revised, with full respect for due process and effective remedies.


We therefore welcome the legislation as a significant but fragile first step. Its promise will depend on whether it is followed by inclusion, legal certainty, reconciliation, democratic reform and concrete measures in Turkey and Europe that transform the end of armed conflict into a sustainable and just peace.


We therefore urge:


•

 

The Turkish authorities and Parliament to develop a comprehensive reconciliation process throughout Turkey, accompanied by democratic and legal reforms protecting Kurdish identity, language and cultural rights, equal citizenship, political participation, freedom of expression and association, and the rule of law.

author: CMI Argentina
title: El EAAF anunció un nuevo hallazgo de restos humanos en el predio de La Perla
content:
Según lo anunció el Equipo Argentino de Antropología Forense, recientemente se recuperaron restos óseos dispersos y desarticulados en sedimentos de relleno en una zona adyacente a la explorada durante la primera etapa y que ya había arrojado resultados positivos. En efecto, sobre los restos hallados en 2025 se identificaron y comunicaron 29 identidades de personas -12 se revelaron en marzo y 17 en mayo de este año- mientras que otros seis perfiles genéticos permanecen sin identificar. Ahora se suma un nuevo conjunto de restos óseos que ya fueron enviados para su análisis antropológico al laboratorio del Servicio de Antropología Forense del Instituto de Medicina Forense del Poder Judicial de Córdoba, que coopera en el proyecto.


Alvaro “Chino” Corral


En lo que va de la segunda etapa de trabajos de prospección y excavación arqueológica en el sitio Loma del Torito –comenzó en mayo y seguirá en octubre de 2026 dentro de un área de aproximadamente tres hectáreas del predio donde funcionó el centro clandestino de detención La Perla, en Córdoba- se produjeron nuevos hallazgos y recuperación de restos óseos de personas desaparecidas.


De acuerdo a la información difundida por el Equipo Argentino de Antropología Forense (EAAF), este nuevo conjunto de restos óseos ya fueron enviados para su análisis antropológico al laboratorio del Servicio de Antropología Forense del Instituto de Medicina Forense del Poder Judicial de Córdoba, que coopera en el proyecto.


Luego pasarán a ser estudiados por el Laboratorio de Genética Forense del EAAF y finalmente –tal como ya ocurrió en dos oportunidades desde los primeros hallazgos- será comunicada a las familias y difundida al público en general la identidad de las personas que durante la última dictadura cívico militar fueron asesinadas y sus cuerpos luego fueron enterrados clandestinamente con el objeto de ocultar los crímenes.


Cabe recordar que los trabajos en curso fueron ordenados por el Juzgado Federal de Córdoba N° 3, a cargo del juez Hugo Vaca Narvaja, y junto al EAAF colabora la Universidad Nacional de Córdoba y el Departamento de Geología de la Universidad Nacional de Río Cuarto, en tanto que el Gobierno provincial y la Municipalidad de Córdoba brindan apoyo logístico y provisión de diversos recursos.


Respecto a la tarea de identificar a las víctimas y como lo hace habitualmente, El EAAF convoca a familias que tengan un persona desaparecida entre 1974 y 1983 a aportar su muestra de sangre de forma confidencial, gratuita y voluntaria, comunicándose al WhatsApp +54911 2348 5229, al teléfono 0800 345 3236 o al correo electrónico a iniciativa@eaaf.org.


El centro clandestino de detención La Perla funcionó desde 1976 y hasta 1978, y fue uno de los más grandes del país. Se ubicó en un predio del III Cuerpo del Ejército -entre Córdoba capital y Carlos Paz- bajo el mando de Luciano Benjamín Menéndez.


El 24 de julio de 2008 se produjo el primer veredicto condenatorio sobre los crímenes cometidos en La Perla, con una pena de prisión perpetua paras Menéndez y también hubo condenas para otros siete militares.

title: "Regime Change" Author Maggie Haberman on Trump's Imperial Presidency, Epstein Files & War on Iran
content:
President Trump’s son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem on Monday after Israel rejected a 15-point plan for Gaza promoted by President Trump’s “Board of Peace.” The proposal would have seen Hamas gradually disarm and turn over governance of Gaza to an international force in exchange for Israel’s withdrawal from the besieged territory.


Israel, supported by Kushner, is pushing for a deal whereby it “would not be obliged to conduct any of its obligations unless and until Hamas was fully disarmed,” says Middle East analyst Mouin Rabbani. “This is essentially Israel throwing a poison pill into an agreement by including conditions that can never be met.”


Rabbani argues that Jared Kushner is not a suitable negotiator because there is a “very intimate ideological, political connection between the Kushners and Israel.”

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Embajador de EE UU amenaza a cooperativa por compra de tecnología china
content:
Citan al embajador de EE UU por sus amenazas a la cooperativa CALF, que denunció ante Diputados las presiones de la Embajada de Estados Unidos para que abandonara sus acuerdos con Huawei, incluido un proyecto de fibra óptica y un data center en Vaca Muerta.


Por Mario Hernandez


Sus directivos señalaron que recibieron amenazas de retiro de visas y reclamaron defender la autonomía tecnológica del país. Tras la denuncia, la Comisión de Asuntos Cooperativos confirmó que citará al embajador Peter Lamelas para que dé explicaciones ante el Congreso.


La convocatoria fue impulsada por el diputado de Unión por la Patria, Aldo Leiva, presidente de la Comisión de Asuntos Cooperativos, Mutuales y Organizaciones No Gubernamentales de la Cámara de Diputados. El legislador citó a Lamelas para el miércoles 19 de agosto, luego de que los representantes de CALF expusieran ante la Comisión las presuntas presiones recibidas por parte de funcionarios de la Embajada estadounidense.


El conflicto surgió a partir de una serie de contactos entre representantes de la Embajada de Estados Unidos y autoridades de la cooperativa neuquina, vinculados con los proyectos que CALF desarrolla junto a Huawei. Según denunciaron los dirigentes de la entidad, durante esas comunicaciones se plantearon objeciones a la relación comercial y hasta se habría advertido sobre posibles consecuencias vinculadas con las visas de integrantes de la conducción de la cooperativa.


La controversia se da en torno a proyectos tecnológicos vinculados con la expansión de infraestructura de telecomunicaciones en Neuquén, entre ellos un tendido de fibra óptica en la zona de Vaca Muerta y la instalación de un centro de datos.


La tecnología china en Vaca Muerta: “No va a ayudar a traer inversiones”


Los representantes de CALF plantearon ante Diputados que las comunicaciones recibidas desde la representación diplomática estadounidense constituían una intromisión en la autonomía de la cooperativa. La entidad sostuvo que mantiene vínculos comerciales con empresas de distintos países y que su decisión de trabajar con Huawei responde a criterios vinculados con costos, financiamiento y tecnología.


El caso escaló luego de que Lamelas defendiera públicamente la posición estadounidense y argumentara que las decisiones relacionadas con visas forman parte de las facultades de Washington y están vinculadas con la protección de sus intereses y su seguridad nacional.


La posición generó cuestionamientos desde Unión por la Patria, que puso el foco en la posibilidad de que una representación diplomática extranjera haya intentado condicionar una decisión comercial tomada por una organización argentina.


Aldo Leiva cuestionó la actuación que se le atribuye a la Embajada de Estados Unidos y sostuvo que el caso debe ser analizado como una cuestión vinculada con la soberanía argentina.


“Nos parece inadmisible”, afirmó el diputado, al considerar que no se puede permitir que una embajada ejerza una presión de esa naturaleza sobre una cooperativa ni sobre cualquier argentino o empresa que desarrolle una actividad dentro del marco de las leyes nacionales y del comercio internacional.


“Estoy convencido, de acuerdo a lo que dijeron los dirigentes de la cooperativa, que se avasalló y se presionó, pasando todos los límites que puede eventualmente tener una embajada, en este caso la Embajada estadounidense”, sostuvo Leiva.


El legislador remarcó además que el planteo no está dirigido exclusivamente contra Estados Unidos, sino que busca establecer un límite frente a cualquier representación diplomática extranjera que pretenda intervenir en decisiones de actores argentinos.


“El objetivo que perseguimos es no solamente por esta cuestión de la Embajada de los Estados Unidos, sino cualquier embajada que tenga presencia en nuestro país”, explicó.


En esa línea, Leiva vinculó el episodio con la defensa de la soberanía nacional. “La soberanía debemos defenderla en todos los ámbitos”, afirmó, y señaló que el respaldo a la posición de CALF cuenta con el acompañamiento del bloque de Unión por la Patria.


La Comisión que preside Leiva ya formalizó

la convocatoria para que Lamelas concurra al Congreso el 19 de agosto

 y dé explicaciones sobre las denuncias formuladas por la cooperativa.

title: A seis meses de lucha en FATE: conferencia de prensa y jornada frente a la fábrica
content:
Foto: Eduardo Sarapura, para Tiempo Argentino.


Este lunes 18 de agosto se cumplen seis meses del lock out patronal en FATE y los trabajadores del neumático volverán a las calles para sostener el reclamo por la continuidad de la planta. La convocatoria del Sindicato Único de Trabajadores del Neumático Argentino (SUTNA) anuncia una gran jornada de lucha, que tendrá como uno de sus puntos centrales una conferencia de prensa a las 13 en la Seccional San Fernando del sindicato. Además de la conferencia, habrá actividades en la puerta de la fábrica, en una jornada en la que los trabajadores volverán a plantear el rechazo al cierre y exigirán la continuidad laboral, el fin del lock out y la puesta en marcha de FATE, y anunciarán nuevas acciones de lucha. La actividad reunirá a dirigentes de distintos gremios y organizaciones, entre ellos Pablo Moyano, Hugo Yasky, Rodolfo Aguiar, Daniel Yofra, Claudio Marín y Alejandro Gramajo.

Por ANRed.


Este lunes 18 de agosto se cumplen

seis meses del lock out patronal en FATE

 y los trabajadores del neumático realizarán una nueva jornada de lucha para sostener el reclamo por la continuidad de la planta y los puestos de trabajo. La actividad tendrá como uno de sus puntos centrales una c

onferencia de prensa a las 13 en la Seccional San Fernando del Sindicato Único de Trabajadores del Neumático Argentino (SUTNA)

, ubicada en Paul Harris 2960, en la localidad bonaerense de Victoria.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por SUTNA (@sutnanacional)


La convocatoria anticipa la presencia de representantes de dirigentes de distintos sectores sindicales y sociales, entre ellos, Pablo Moyano (Camioneros), Hugo Yasky (CTA de los Trabajadores de Argentina), Cachorro Godoy (CTA Autónoma), Rodolfo Aguiar (ATE Nacional) , Colo Isassi (ATE Provincia de Bs. As.), Daniel Yofra (Aceiteros Nacional), Ezequiel Roldán (Aceiteros Capital), Claudio Marín (Telefónicos), Pollo Sobrero (Unión Ferroviaria Haedo), Alejandro Gramajo (UTEP), Chiquito Belliboni (Polo Obrero), Romina del Plá (Suteba La Matanza), Laura Carboni (AGD), y Nora Biaggio (Jubilados).


Durante la conferencia, «

se anunciarán nuevas acciones de lucha

 para concretar el justo reclamo de todos los trabajadores, garantizando la continuidad laboral, el fin del lock out y la puesta en marcha de la única fabricante de neumáticos para camiones y colectivos de la Argentina», remarca la convocartoria.


Para la jornada de este lunes, además de la conferencia de prensa, la convocatoria anuncia actividades en la puerta de la fábrica y plantea una perspectiva que excede el conflicto particular del ssector del neumático: «contra la entrega y destrucción de recursos estratégicos del país, tierras, industria, controles, educación, salud, jubilaciones y contra la quita de todo aquello que obligue al pueblo argentino a la dependencia absoluta de capitales extranjeros».


El conflicto de FATE se inició con el cierre de la planta y, desde entonces, los trabajadores vienen sosteniendo distintas medidas para defender sus fuentes laborales. En este marco, en junio de este año,

la Justicia avanzó con la citación a indagatoria de 24 trabajadores y dirigentes del SUTNA, entre ellos su secretario general, Alejandro Crespo

, en el marco de una causa iniciada a partir de la permanencia en la fábrica.


En paralelo, durante ese mes creció la

amenaza de un desalojo de la planta

. Los trabajadores realizaron entonces una

caravana y banderazo contra esa posibilidad y por la reapertura de la empresa

, mientras distintas organizaciones obreras de la Zona Norte expresaron su solidaridad con el conflicto. La lucha también llegó a la Panamericana: a principios de julio de este año,

trabajadores de FATE, Georgalos y Lustramax realizaron un corte total de la autopista en defensa de sus puestos de trabajo

. La protesta se inscribió en una coordinación de distintos conflictos laborales de la zona norte del conurbano.


En ese marco, desde el sindicato también se impulsó una propuesta de ocupación temporaria de la planta para garantizar la continuidad productiva, mientras que un proyecto presentado en el Congreso plantea declarar de interés público nacional y carácter estratégico la continuidad de la producción de neumáticos y dispone la ocupación temporaria de la planta industrial de FATE.

title: Parco eolico tra Gorgona e Capraia, nuovo scempio all’orizzonte
content:
Riceviamo e pubblichiamo molto volentieri questo articolo da parte della Scrivania Autogestita d’Informazione di Livorno (qui l’articolo

https://scrivaniautogestita.it/parco-eolico-tra-gorgona-e-capraia-nuovo-scempio-allorizzonte/

) in merito al nuovo progetto di mega impianto eolico off shore in zona protetta tra Gorgona e Capraia. Iniziamo ad approfondire questo nuovo scempio voluto da ENI e che ben si inserisce nel quadro complessivo di una terra oggetto di speculazione energetica da parte delle grandi compagnie. I Comuni interessati fanno parte di un territorio già segnato da impianti di agrivoltaico e fotovoltaico e progetti eolici, come nel caso del Comune di Suvereto dove si è tenuta una marcia popolare promossa dal Comitato Terre Val di Cornia (di cui abbiamo parlato qui

https://infoaut.org/confluenza/val-di-cornia-una-manifestazione-a-suvereto-per-difendere-i-terreni-agricoli-da-terna-e-maxi-progetti-speculativi

) ; la Toscana è una di quelle regioni in cui gli investimenti in questo ambito si intrecciano con gli interessi sporchi di sangue di grandi società finanziatrici israeliane, come nel caso di Massarosa e nel più recente di Ribolla (se ne è parlato anche su quotidiani nazionali e qui si trova il loro sito

https://dirittinpalestina.blog/

), dove è nato un comitato per contrastare il progetto. Seguiranno aggiornamenti! Buona lettura.


Il progetto del nuovo parco eolico Atis che dovrebbe sorgere tra l’isola di Gorgona e l’isola di Capraia è in fase di Valutazione di Impatto Ambientale. Diverse le criticità e le contrarietà espresse da associazioni ed enti per un’opera che impatterà in maniera irreversibile su un’area ad elevato interesse naturale e paesaggistico essendo situata all’interno dell’area marina protetta Santuario Pelagos e della Rete Natura 2000 con aree classificate come Zona Speciale di Conservazione e Protezione Speciale. A ridosso del Parco Nazionale Arcipelago Toscano e al Parc naturel marin du Cap Corse et de l’Agriate in Corsica, passando per la Riserva Naturale Tombolo di Cecina. In una regione, la Toscana, già altamente stressata da impianti logistici, energetici e industriali.


Ma andiamo con ordine.


Cos’è e chi lo promuove?


Atis è il nuovo parco eolico flottante offshore che dovrebbe sorgere tra l’isola di Gorgona e l’isola di Capraia. Promosso da Atis Floating Wind S.r.l, joint venture tra Eni Plenitude e Simply Blue Group, costerà circa 2,98 miliardi di euro.


Eni Plenitude è una società per azioni controllata da Eni che vende luce, gas e soluzioni energetiche varie. 


Simply Blue Group è una società irlandese con sede a Cork specializzata nello sviluppo di progetti per la cosiddetta “blue economy” cioè l’energia pulita proveniente dal mare.


Già dal 2023 le due società hanno firmato un accordo per lo sviluppo di parchi eolici in Italia.


Caratteristiche.


Il progetto prevede l’installazione di 48 turbine eoliche galleggianti, che saranno ancorate ai fondali. Le turbine avranno un diametro delle pale di 250 m e il mozzo posizionato a 157 metri sopra il livello del mare. Il parco occuperà 264,5 km2 in una zona dove i fondali oscillano tra i 250 e 630 metri. Gli aerogeneratori avranno una potenza stimata di 48 MW per una potenza complessiva di 864 MW e una produzione stimata di 1860 gigawatt ora. 


L’elettricità generata verrà raccolta da due grosse sottostazioni elettriche galleggianti (chiamate Foss) posizionate in mare. 


Da lì, partiranno 4 cavi sottomarini che trasporteranno l’energia fino al punto di approdo a terra, individuato nel Comune di Rosignano Marittimo. Infine, un cavidotto interrato collegherà l’approdo alla stazione di connessione della rete elettrica nazionale di Terna a Castellina Marittima (Pi). Successivamente, tramite un elettrodotto in gran parte aereo, si collegherà alla stazione elettrica di Castellina con quella di Cornia.


Per la realizzazione dell’approdo dei cavi sottomarini è previsto l’utilizzo di Trivellazione Orizzontale Controllata.


Posizione.


Il parco eolico sorgerà a

 

circa 17 km dall’Isola di Gorgona, 22 km dall’isola Capraia, 28 km dalla punta settentrionale della Corsica e circa 55 km dalla costa di Calafuria, a Livorno. 


I comuni interessati dalle opere di connessione onshore (cavidotto interrato ed elettrodotto aereo) sono: Rosignano Marittimo (LI), Castellina Marittima (PI), Riparbella (PI), Montescudaio (PI), Guardistallo (PI), Casale Marittimo (PI), Bibbona (LI), Castagneto Carducci (LI), Sassetta (LI) e …

author: A.N.A.
title: Chamada de artigos para “História Regional”: Anarquismos e anarquistas frente à revolução cubana
content:
Nos últimos anos, os estudos sobre o movimento ácrata na América Latina experimentaram uma notável renovação historiográfica, em termos temáticos, metodológicos e arquivísticos. Entre seus traços principais, destacam-se o interesse por suas dimensões político-culturais em sentido amplo, a articulação de diversas escalas analíticas, o estudo de redes transnacionais, a ampliação das temporalidades e o reconhecimento de uma pluralidade de anarquismos.


Embora durante décadas as pesquisas tenham privilegiado um arco temporal centrado na passagem do século XIX para o XX, trabalhos recentes deram conta dos complexos rumos do movimento no continente após a década de 1930. E, ainda que a Guerra Civil Espanhola costume ser apresentada como o golpe de misericórdia ao anarquismo no Ocidente, essas investigações atuais não apenas demonstram sua posterior reorganização, como também apontam como a experiência peninsular se constituiu em um prisma privilegiado a partir do qual os setores libertários interpretaram suas próprias conjunturas políticas e ideológicas. No entanto, apesar desses avanços, ainda persiste uma lacuna no estudo do movimento em relação aos projetos geopolíticos da ordem bipolar surgida após a Segunda Guerra Mundial: o capitalismo ocidental e o comunismo soviético.


Nessa linha, o presente Dossiê propõe reunir artigos que investiguem as ações, itinerários, posicionamentos, discursos e debates de diversas organizações e individualidades anarquistas da América Latina e do Caribe diante de um dos processos mais disruptivos da era bipolar: a Revolução Cubana de 1959, sua gesta e seus desdobramentos. Com o propósito de aprofundar o estudo de um objeto de abordagem recente, busca-se examinar em que medida esse fenômeno histórico operou como esperança revolucionária e/ou como fator de fratura e reconfiguração do movimento anarquista. Para isso, convida-se a trabalhos que abordem esse problema de pesquisa a partir de um variado corpus (que contempla literatura especializada, imprensa anarquista e de outras esquerdas, documentação organizacional, correspondência, entrevistas, memórias e manifestações artísticas) e que apliquem uma abordagem multiescalar capaz de entrelaçar as dimensões local, regional, nacional e transnacional. Entre os eixos temáticos possíveis, sugerem-se: as redes de solidariedade e o exílio; os debates ideológicos na imprensa; a juventude e as Novas Esquerdas; e os itinerários biográficos.


Desse modo, pretende-se contribuir para o fortalecimento do campo de estudos sobre os anarquismos na região, uma área dinamizada nas últimas décadas pela abertura e consolidação de arquivos especializados, pela realização periódica de encontros acadêmicos e por uma crescente produção editorial.


COORDENADORES DO DOSSIÊ


Luciano Oneto (CeDInCI-CONICET, UNC): 

luciano.omar.oneto@gmail.com


Daniel Trejo (UNAM, Colbach): 

rotesdaniel@gmail.com

Em caso de dúvida, por favor, escrevam para os coordenadores e/ou para a secretaria da revista.

title: [Espanha] La Casika não se toca: 29 anos de autogestão contra o despejo
content:
A Casika é um Centro Social Ocupado e Autogestionado (CSOA) localizado em Móstoles (Madri) que, desde 1997, serve como espaço de encontro, cultura, organização e luta para diferentes gerações e movimentos sociais. Durante quase três décadas, construiu, a partir da autogestão, um lugar aberto a iniciativas sociais, políticas e culturais, tornando-se um dos espaços autogestionados históricos da Comunidade de Madri.

 

No próximo dia 6 de outubro de 2026, a Casika enfrentará uma nova ameaça de despejo. Quase 29 anos depois de este espaço ter iniciado sua trajetória em Móstoles, mais uma vez está ameaçado um dos referenciais históricos da autogestão e dos movimentos sociais da cidade.

 

A história da Casika começa em 1997. Desde então, suas paredes abrigaram shows, oficinas, encontros, atividades culturais e políticas, iniciativas de apoio mútuo e uma infinidade de coletivos e lutas sociais.

 

Mas a Casika é muito mais do que o prédio que ocupa. Durante quase três décadas, foi um lugar para se encontrar, se organizar e construir a partir da base, estreitamente ligado ao bairro, à classe trabalhadora e àqueles que defendem outras formas de construir comunidade à margem das lógicas do mercado.

 

29 ANOS RESISTINDO

 

A ameaça atual não é a primeira. A história da Casika é marcada por diferentes tentativas de despejo, processos judiciais e campanhas em defesa do espaço.

 

E, apesar de tudo, a Casika continua lá.

 

São quase 29 anos de resistência, autogestão, cultura popular, solidariedade e memória coletiva. Agora, segundo comunicou a própria Assembleia da Casika, o processo chegou a um momento decisivo e o dia 6 de outubro está marcado como a data para o despejo.

 

Não estamos falando apenas de fechar um prédio. Estamos falando de colocar em risco um espaço construído coletivamente durante quase três décadas e de tentar apagar uma parte da memória daqueles que demonstraram que é possível se organizar sem pedir permissão.

 

Esta nova ameaça chega, além disso, em um contexto marcado pelo avanço de posições fascistas, reacionárias e autoritárias no Estado espanhol e de discursos que criminalizam o protesto, a ocupação e as formas de organização que fogem às lógicas institucionais e do mercado. E ocorre, paradoxalmente, sob o denominado durante anos como “Governo mais progressista da história”, enquanto espaços populares e autogestionados continuam enfrentando despejos, especulação e criminalização.

 

Frente ao individualismo e à mercantilização de nossas cidades, a autogestão, o apoio mútuo e a organização coletiva seguem sendo ferramentas imprescindíveis de resistência.

 

A CASIKA CONVOCA À MOBILIZAÇÃO

 

A Casika anunciou uma campanha de solidariedade e mobilização em vista do despejo.

 

Nos dias 11 e 12 de setembro, haverá shows e atividades coincidindo com as festas de Móstoles, e nos dias 25 e 26 de setembro serão realizadas novas atividades em apoio ao espaço.

 

No dia 3 de outubro, está prevista uma manifestação que terminará na Casika, seguida de uma festa. Três dias depois, no dia 6 de outubro, chegará a data marcada para o despejo.

 

A CGT Andaluzia, Ceuta e Melilha quer contribuir para estender a solidariedade com a Casika. Incentivamos a divulgar as convocações e a participar das atividades e mobilizações que ocorrerão durante setembro e outubro.

 

Para conhecer as próximas convocações, atividades e novidades sobre a campanha contra o despejo, você pode seguir diretamente a Casika CSOA através de seu perfil oficial no Instagram: @lacasika.csoa.

 

Porque 29 anos de história, luta e organização coletiva não desaparecem com uma ordem de despejo.

 

Como lembra a Assembleia da Casika em um de seus comunicados diante desta nova ameaça:

 

“PODERÃO DESPEJAR NOSSAS CASAS,

MAS NUNCA NOSSAS IDEIAS”.

RESISTIMOS E RESISTIREMOS.

A CASIKA NÃO SE TOCA!

title: Armut als Mileis Erfolg: Argentinien hat die niedrigsten Löhne in Lateinamerika und einen Mindestlohn unter dem von 2001
content:
Dossier


„

Argentinische Arbeitnehmer erhalten die niedrigsten Löhne in Lateinamerika, und der Rückgang ist historisch, so ein Bericht des Lateinamerikanischen Strategiezentrums für Geopolitik (Celag). Im September 2025 lag der Realmindestlohn unter dem Niveau von 2001, vor dem Zusammenbruch der Konvertibilität. In der Casa Rosada gibt man zu, dass die Regierung von Javier Milei das Einkommen der Arbeiter als“Anker der Anpassung und der Verlangsamung der Inflation“ benutzt hat. Und die Zahlen belegen dies.Die Celag hat herausgefunden, dass der argentinische Mindestlohn (Stand November 2025) der niedrigste in der gesamten Region ist. Mit nur 225 Dollar rangiert er am unteren Ende der Tabelle, hinter Bolivien, Paraguay und weit hinter Costa Rica, das mit 729 Dollar an der Spitze liegt. (…) Ein Bericht der Facultad de Ciencias Económicas de la UBA weist zudem darauf hin, dass der Salario Mínimo, Vital y Móvil zwischen November 2023 und September 2025 34 % seiner Kaufkraft verlieren wird

…“ span.

Beitrag vom 17. November 2025 in Página|12


 (maschinenübersetzt) und Beispiele wie Widerstand:


“No se banca más”: Woche der Proteste gegen den Verschuldungskurs in Argentinien mündet am Donnerstag im Marsch zum Wirtschaftsministerium in Buenos Aires


Mileis Verelendungskurs trifft Millionen. Argentinien: Gewerkschaften und soziale Bewegungen protestieren gegen eine Regierung, die breite Bevölkerungsschichten in Armut stürzt


„Widerstand sichtbar machen – mit einem Protesttag am Donnerstag in der argentinischen Hauptstadt Buenos Aires, als Demonstration gegen die Politik der sozialen Verelendung breiter Bevölkerungsschichten durch die Regierung von Javier Milei: Die Gewerkschaftsdachverbände CGT und CTA rufen gemeinsam mit der Unión de Trabajadores y Trabajadoras de la Economía Popular UTEP (Gewerkschaft marginalisierter Arbeiter und Arbeiterinnen), sozialen Bewegungen und Schuldnergruppen zu einem »Marsch der Verschuldeten« vor dem Wirtschaftsministerium auf. Die Mobilisierung ist Teil eines im Juli gestarteten Aktionsplans, der auf die ruinösen Folgen der rechtslibertären Wirtschaftspolitik aufmerksam machen soll. Bereits am Vormittag wollen Vertreter kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen protestieren. Sie beklagen die Schließung von 26.000 Betrieben seit Mileis Amtsantritt.


Mit den Protesten weisen die Organisatoren auch auf ein zunehmendes Schuldenproblem hin, das nach offiziellen Zahlen der Zentralbank bereits 5,8 Millionen Menschen betrifft, die Kredite nicht mehr tilgen können. Die tatsächliche Zahl der Überschuldeten liegt deutlich höher, denn viele leihen sich Geld bei informellen Anbietern, Nachbarn oder kriminellen Verleihern. Immer mehr nehmen die Kredite nicht für größere Anschaffungen auf, sondern um Lebensmittel zu kaufen, ihre Mieten und Stromrechnungen zu bezahlen oder andere elementare Ausgaben zu decken. Die Verschuldung wird so zum Ersatz für ein Einkommen, das zum Leben nicht reicht.


Eine Ursache sehen Gewerkschaften vor allem im Auseinanderdriften von Lebenshaltungskosten und Einkommen. Der Mindestlohn liegt im August bei monatlich 376.600 Pesos (218 Euro), während eine vierköpfige Familie im Juli nach den Angaben des Statistikamtes INDEC bereits 1,56 Millionen Pesos benötigte, um nicht als arm zu gelten. Während die Reallöhne der Beschäftigten im privaten Sektor im Juni erneut sanken, stieg die Inflation im Juli auf 2,1 Prozent im Monatsvergleich und lag seit Jahresbeginn bei 19,3 Prozent. Wirtschaftsminister Luis Caputo weist jede Verantwortung der Politik zurück und erklärt die Überschuldung mit der souveränen Entscheidung der Betroffenen, Kredite zu hohen Zinsen aufgenommen zu haben. Milei selbst bezeichnete das Schuldenproblem als Angelegenheit zwischen Privatpersonen

…“

Artikel von Volker Hermsdorf in der jungen Welt vom 18.08.2026

title: Nueva semana de lucha de la docencia universitaria
content:
Los trabajadores y las trabajadoras nucleadas en Conadu Histórica realizarán un paro nacional de cinco días entre el 18 y el 22 de agosto en universidades nacionales en reclamo por una deuda salarial del 28,5%, y para exigir la implementación de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario, que suma ya 300 días de incumplimiento por parte del gobierno nacional. En tanto, los agrupados en Conadu instalarán durante los mismos días una carpa frente al Palacio Pizzurno y no descartan medidas de fuerza para la siguiente semana.

Por Red Eco Alternativo.


Desde la Conadu Histórica, convocan a una semana de paro nacional de la docencia universitaria y preuniversitaria, del 18 al 22 de agosto. Advierten que el gobierno nacional continúa incumpliendo la ley y mantiene una deuda salarial que, a junio, alcanza el 28,5 %, sin recomposición salarial en julio y con la misma perspectiva para agosto.


Frente a esta situación, exigen: Recomposición salarial; pago inmediato del 28,5 % adeudado a junio, más los retroactivos correspondientes; restitución y pago del FONID; actualización de la garantía salarial; fondos para capacitación; cumplimiento pleno de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario.


En tanto, desde Conadu organizan la instalación de una Carpa por la Universidad y la Soberanía entre el 18 y el 21 de agosto, frente al Palacio Pizzurno, donde se desarrollarán diferentes actividades.


El martes 18, a partir de las 11, habrá semaforazo, un panel con la participación de integrantes del Observatorio de Tierras e Inquilinos Agrupados, y la actuación de la Murga Proteína G. Además, a las 16, el Frente de Sindicatos Unidos presentará el Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil de los trabajadores con los valores del mes de julio.


Por su parte, el miércoles 19, a las 11, se hará un Banderazo. Las actividades continuarán el resto de la semana.

title: Bayramoğlu: The real process will begin with implementation of law
content:
Writer Ali Bayramoğlu said the Framework Law passed by the General Assembly of Parliament does not in itself provide a solution to the Kurdish question, but represents a historic threshold in the transition from a period of armed struggle to one of political struggle.


Bayramoğlu said the implementation of the law, verification of the laying down of arms, and mechanisms to be established concerning the status of detainees and convicted prisoners would be critical issues in the coming period. In his remarks to ANF, he said the main debate would begin when the democratic demands of the Kurds come onto the agenda.


Bayramoğlu described the new process initiated by the Framework Law as an important turning point in the history of the Kurdish question and said the legislation should not be viewed solely in terms of the laying down of arms or as a legal arrangement.


He said the Kurdish question in Turkey had been politicized since the 1830s, during the reign of Mahmud II, and that the armed struggle that began with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) around 40 to 50 years ago, following uprisings and protests throughout the history of the Republic, had broadened the political dimension of the Kurdish question.


Bayramoğlu said the Framework Law represents a critical threshold indicating that nearly half a century of armed struggle is beginning to give way to political struggle. He stressed that the legislation does not in itself constitute a solution to the Kurdish question, but carries historic significance in moving the search for a solution onto the political ground.


A critical and vital milestone


Bayramoğlu described the Framework Law as a “critical and vital milestone” for the Kurdish question and Turkey's relationship with the issue, but said it could not yet be described as a paradigm shift. He said more decisive steps on the Kurdish question would be needed before such a shift could be said to have taken place. At the current stage, he said, the main change lies not in the resolution of the Kurdish question itself, but in the transition towards political means in the search for a solution. He added that the removal of violence and arms from the equation through mutual agreement was significant in itself.


Bayramoğlu said the process was not merely about laying down arms and also pointed to statements by Abdullah Öcalan. He said Öcalan's writings and statements could be read as indicating that armed struggle had reached the limits of what it could achieve for the Kurds and that political means could bring greater gains from this point onward. He added that the scope for pursuing gains through armed struggle was also becoming increasingly limited in the Middle East.


Bayramoğlu said that, by contrast, the recognition of differences, rights and identity through political means in the countries where Kurds live could pave the way for a broader process in the fields of culture, literature and poetry. For this reason, he described the current stage as a historic period.


A complex and minefield-laden path


Bayramoğlu said it was impossible to predict with certainty how the process would unfold and warned that the risks of setbacks and reversals in the coming period could not be overlooked. Nevertheless, he said the overall direction for both the Kurdish movement and the state was towards a political ground, while noting that significant differences remained between their respective objectives.


Bayramoğlu said the state's primary expectation was the laying down of arms and the transformation of the organization away from an armed structure, while the Kurdish movement wanted to continue through political means the struggle it had previously pursued. He stressed that the current period would be a phase in which common ground between these two different approaches would be sought.


Implementation of the law is the first critical threshold


Bayramoğlu added that the significance of the Framework Law could not be assessed solely in terms of the process of laying down arms and pointed to important uncertainties surrounding its implementation. He said the first critical threshold in the coming period would be how the mechanisms envisaged by the law would operate and how the laying down of arms would be verified:

content:

„…

Kurz bevor die Kitas (und auch die Kindertagespflege sollte hier ausdrücklich erwähnt werden, wo fast 50.000 Tageseltern unterwegs sind und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Versorgung leisten) in den Strudel der Coronavirus-Folgen gezogen wurden, gab es mal wieder Zahlen aus der Welt des Mangels (…) Der von Beckmann gegebene Hinweis auf einen „sich selbst verstärkenden Teufelskreis“ – Personalmangel führt zu zusätzlichen Belastungen bei den Erzieherinnen und Erziehern, höhere Krankenstände sind die Folge, das erhöht wiederum die Arbeitsbelastung der verbleibenden Fachkräfte und gefährdet deren Gesundheit zusätzlich

Beitrag vom 16. März 2020 von und bei Stefan Sell

 

, siehe dazu:


Nur jede siebte Kita in Deutschland hat die von der Wissenschaft empfohlene Personalbesetzung – marode Räume verschärfen die problematische Situation


„

Die Situation in vielen Kitas wirkt sich auf Eltern und vor allem die Kinder negativ aus. Bildungsexpertinnen und Eltern schlagen Alarm.


Hamburg – In Deutschlands Kitas fehlt es an Personal. Eine Erhebung des Deutschen Kitaleitungskongresses (DKLK) Anfang des Jahres offenbart das Ausmaß: Etwa jede zweite der 5.008 befragten Einrichtungsleitungen berichtet, mindestens einmal wöchentlich mit unzureichender Personaldecke auskommen zu müssen. Noch drastischer: Neun Prozent aller Kitas operieren mehr als 60 Prozent ihrer Betriebszeit unterhalb der vorgeschriebenen Besetzung. Nur jede siebte Kita in Deutschland hat die von der Wissenschaft empfohlene Personalbesetzung, um eine gute frühkindliche Bildung und Erziehung für alle Kinder in der jeweiligen Einrichtung zu gewährleisten: Das ist das Ergebnis einer Studie der Bertelsmann Stiftung zu den Personalausstattungsquoten in deutschen Kitas

.

(…)


Die Expertin für frühkindliche Bildung erklärt gegenüber der Frankfurter Rundschau: „Wenn zu wenig ausgebildetes Personal in den Einrichtungen ist, ist eine dialogorientierte Sprachförderung der Kinder nicht möglich, weil den Fachkräften schlicht die Zeit für das einzelne Kind fehlt.“ Entscheidend sei das Qualifikationsniveau der Beschäftigten. Fehle es an beidem – Personal und Ausbildung –, reduziere sich die Kommunikation mit den Kindern auf bloße Anweisungen.


Marode Räume verschärfen die problematische KIta-Situation


Während der Fachkräftemangel grassiert, sparen manche Kommunen ausgerechnet bei der Infrastruktur. Der Deutsche Kitaverband kritisiert: Auch bauliche Mängel beeinträchtigen die Qualität frühkindlicher Bildung erheblich. In Berlin entsprächen viele Spielplätze und Gruppenräume längst nicht mehr zeitgemäßen Standards

Artikel von Pia Seitler vom 18.08.2026 in der FR online


 („„Kinder verlieren Halt“ – Trend in deutschen Kitas nimmt riskante Ausmaße an“)


SOS Kita: Kurz vor dem Kollaps. Fachkräftemangel, Krankenstand, BurnOut – die Situation in Deutschlands Kitas ist dramatisch. Und die Belastung steigt weiter.


„

Die neuen Zahlen des „Ländermonitoring Frühkindliche Bildungssysteme“ sind alarmierend. Bundesweit kämpfen Beschäftigte für bessere Bedingungen und mehr Personal – in Berlin für einen Tarifvertrag Entlastung


Vor Monaten haben Beschäftigte aus Kindertagesstätten die Initiative SOS Kita ins Leben gerufen. Sie fordern bessere Bedingungen und mehr Personal – mit bundesweite Gefährdungsanzeigen, Protesten, Aktionenn und Mahnwachen und einer erste Tarifauseinandersetzung „Für Pädagogische Qualität und Entlastung“ in Berlin wollen die Kita-Beschäftigten politisches Gehör erreichen. Doch die Zahlen einer neuen Studie zeigen: Statt einer Verbesserung des Personalschlüssels steigt die Belastung auf die pädagogischen Fachkräfte.


Die Zahlen des aktuellen „Ländermonitoring Frühkindliche Bildungssysteme“ der Bertelsmann-Stiftung sind alarmierend: In Berliner Kitas ist der Anteil ausgebildeter Fachkräfte innerhalb von sechs Jahren von 53 auf 35 Prozent gesunken – ein dramatischer Einbruch. In Brandenburg beträgt der Rückgang zwar nur einen Prozentpunkt auf 81 %, doch die Realität dahinter ist erschreckend: 84 % der Kinder werden in Gruppen mit einem nicht kindgerechten Personalschlüssel betreut, in Berlin sind es 77 %. Dieser Mangel an qualifiziertem Personal ist keine regionale Ausnahme, sondern Ausdruck einer bundesweiten Krise. Immer öfter werden weniger qualifizierte Kräfte oder sogar Auszubildende eingesetzt, um die Lücken zu füllen. title: Immer wieder überraschend: Lehrkräftemangel
content:
Dossier


„

Tausende Lehrkräftestellen können nicht besetzt werden – und die Schülerzahlen werden Prognosen zufolge in den kommenden Jahren weiter steigen. In einigen Bundesländern unterrichten bereits Hunderte Seiteneinsteigerinnen und -einsteiger.


Die Bundesländer haben es verpasst, den Generationenwechsel in den Lehrerzimmern zu organisieren: Überall herrscht Lehrkräftemangel. Die GEW Berlin meldet, 41 Prozent der neueingestellten Lehrkräfte seien Quereinsteigerinnen und -einsteiger, in Sachsen sind es 52 Prozent, an den dortigen Grundschulen sogar 66 Prozent. Um neue Klassen zu bilden und neue Stellen einzurichten, müssten Experten zufolge mehrere Milliarden Euro investiert werden. Die

GEW hat der Politik bereits ein konkretes Maßnahmenpaket vorgelegt


 – inklusive Forderungen wie die Bezahlung aller Lehrkräfte mindestens nach A13 und eine schrittweise Reduzierung der Pflichtstundenzahl..

.“

GEW-Themenseite vom Oktober 2017


 – siehe dort die

E&W 11/2017 zum Schwerpunkt „Lehrkräftemangel“


 und hier dazu, immer wieder (Lehrkräfte sind halt keine Pflegekräfte):


Kultusministerium in Sachsen weitet die „Abordnungen“ aus: „Personalkarussell“ von 5000 Lehrkräften soll den Mangel durch »Gleichverteilung des Elends« kaschieren


5000 sächsische Lehrer müssen an anderen Schulen aushelfen: Anhaltender Personalmangel sorgt für Ausweitung der Abordnungen. Gewerkschaften kritisieren »Personalkarussell« scharf.


„

In Sachsen beginnt an diesem Montag das neue Schuljahr, und 37 600 Kinder erleben ihren ersten Schultag. Ob es sich für sie lohnt, sich die Namen ihrer Lehrer allzu fest einzuprägen, ist fraglich. Denn als Antwort auf den anhaltenden Mangel an Lehrern im Freistaat weitet das Kultusministerium die sogenannten Abordnungen noch einmal deutlich aus. Dabei unterrichten betroffene Lehrkräfte stunden- oder tageweise an anderen als ihrer Stammschule, oft auch in anderen Fächern oder Schularten. Die Gewerkschaft Erziehung und Wissenschaft (GEW) spricht von einem »Personalkarussell«. Zu dessen Folgen gehört, dass auch Schulanfänger mit häufig wechselnden Lehrern konfrontiert sind. (…)

Eine weitere von Ministerium und Schulverwaltung ergriffene Maßnahme sind die Abordnungen. Hintergrund dafür ist, dass der Mangel in manchen Regionen, Schularten und Fächern stärker ausgeprägt ist als in anderen. „

Zur Ankündigung des Sächsischen Kultusministeriums (dpa berichtete), die Abordnungen von Lehrkräften an Schulen mit besonderem Bedarf ab dem Schuljahr 2026/27 auszuweiten, erklärt Claudia Maaß, stellvertretende Vorsitzende der Bildungsgewerkschaft GEW Sachsen:

„Mehr Abordnungen sind keine Lösung, sondern ein Notfallinstrument, das nun zum Dauerzustand wird. Wenn der Minister jetzt sogar ankündigt, es noch auszuweiten, dann ist das kein Handeln, sondern Mangelverwaltung auf dem Rücken der Lehrkräfte.“

Dabei zeigen die Erfahrungen aus den vergangenen Schuljahren, wie gravierend die Folgen dieser Praxis für die betroffenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind. title: Arslan: Turkey must share central powers with local governments - Part One
content:
Discussions on democratic integration and the autonomy of local governments continue in Turkey, while practices of direct democracy around the world continue to shed light on the search for solutions.


In this ANF interview, Mehmet Arslan, former Co-Chair of the Democratic Regions Party (DBP), talked about the struggle for local democracy in Turkey and Switzerland's models of cantonal governance and referendums. Arslan offered assessments on a wide range of issues, from the European Charter of Local Self-Government and trustee policies to the role of young people in politics and social peace.


 


Discussions on democratic integration are continuing in Turkey, while different models and examples are being implemented around the world. Through this interview, we wanted to discuss with you how local democracy can be strengthened, what the European Charter of Local Self-Government entails and what the Swiss model means. Thank you for accepting our invitation.


Thank you for giving me this opportunity, and welcome. For many years, efforts have been made to gradually develop a formula for a solution and new methods based on the forms of struggle surrounding the Kurdish question. Today, with the talks held in Imrali since 27 February 2025 and the declaration of the call for a democratic society, a new search has begun for a way to resolve the Kurdish question through democratic means both in Turkey and across the four parts of Kurdistan.


There is no doubt that if the Kurdish question is to be resolved in Kurdistan and the Middle East, a solution can be reached through more rational and inclusive methods that draw on examples from around the world. The Kurdish question is not independent of global political developments. If the Kurdish question has persisted in the Middle East for a century, international policies have played an important role in leaving the Kurds without a status and in making the issue so complex.


The current democratic society process reached under the leadership of Abdullah Öcalan is the result of a search not only for solutions to the Kurds' own problems, but also for ways in which they can coexist with other peoples in the regions where they live and with peoples around the world within a contemporary legal framework.


You served for a long time as Co-Chair of the DBP. To begin with, how do you define local democracy? What do you think are the fundamental elements of democratic local government?


At the root of social problems lies the question of whether society is included in mechanisms of governance. Problems can only be resolved on a proper and democratic basis through systems of governance in which society participates directly.


During my time as Co-Chair and a member of the Central Executive Board of the Democratic Regions Party, our main aim was not to create a representative structure in which people simply went to the ballot box every four or five years to elect a mayor, MP or council member. On the contrary, we sought a model in which people had a direct say in local government and could make decisions about their own problems.


As is well known, Turkey has entered reservations to significant provisions of the European Charter of Local Self-Government and has not signed up to them. This prevents the development of mechanisms that would involve people in governance beyond the limits set by the central authority. Despite all the difficulties and obstacles, the DBP continued its struggle to govern cities together with the people and transform municipalities into spaces where people could directly address their own problems.


Unfortunately, because of the difficult political environment, the party constantly faced state obstruction in its efforts to fully put its founding philosophy into practice. The trustee policies introduced particularly after 2016 were an intervention against the DBP's perspective of local democracy, developed around the principle, “We will govern ourselves and our cities.” Today, the trustee system is no longer directed solely at Kurdish provinces but has become a broader system of governance. The central government's policies of rejection and denial have repeatedly obstructed society's efforts to govern itself.


You are currently in Switzerland. When you compare the model here with the struggle for local government in Kurdistan, what are the main differences that stand out?

title: Parlak: 'Framework Law' will pave the way for further legal steps
content:
The 'Framework Law' was adopted by the Turkish Parliament's General Assembly in an open vote, with 468 votes in favor, 88 against and 6 abstentions. The bill thus became law with the support of a large majority of the votes cast in the General Assembly. The law, which will remain in force for six months, is expected to take effect after a meeting of the National Security Council and its publication in the Official Gazette. Vezir Parlak, Hakkari (Colemêrg) MP for the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), was among those who witnessed the adoption of the law and the atmosphere that followed. Parlak spoke to ANF about the atmosphere in Parliament and the historic moments, saying, "The next stage is the construction of a democratic society."


Everyone is happy that the same suffering will not be repeated


Vezir Parlak said that tens of thousands of people have struggled through democratic politics for a democratic solution to the Kurdish question, with many risking their lives and continuing the struggle despite exile and imprisonment. He said this legacy has endured to the present day. Parlak said: “What distinguishes us from other movements is that we are one of the most consistent and honorable movements in history. The history of our struggle is full of historic moments, and we are also witnesses to these moments. We can give many examples of historical processes that may have seemed small at the time but led to major changes. The framework bill passed by Parliament can also be viewed in this way. There are reasons that brought all of us together on this ground and led us to struggle. This law can be seen as a preliminary step towards eliminating those reasons. We have endured great suffering. It makes us happy to know that this suffering will not be repeated. Because the fire burns where it falls, and the time has come to warm each other's hearts. In fact, it is already overdue.”


This bill does not resolve the Kurdish question


Parlak said that the Kurdish people have struggled for years for a democratic solution to the Kurdish question and have paid a heavy price in the process. He added that they also have criticisms of the framework bill. Parlak said that despite these criticisms, for the first time, as a result of the Kurdish people's struggle and the state's more realistic approach to the process, there is an effort to address the issue on a legal basis rather than through security-oriented policies. He added that Abdullah Öcalan has attached importance to the role of Parliament since the beginning of the process. Parlak also said: “At the same time, laws on political participation and democratic integration must be enacted in this Parliament. The bill does not resolve the Kurdish question. It offers Kurds an opportunity to resolve their problems through dialogue and negotiation. Perhaps this suffering would never have occurred if a healthy dialogue with the Kurds had been established before. This dialogue must be maintained and negotiations must continue.”


Mr. Öcalan's status must be recognized


Parlak said the provisions of the law were insufficient and that other laws that may be needed could be agreed upon and adopted in Parliament, with the framework law serving as a reference. He added: “For example, the fact that Mr. Öcalan's status has not been recognized is a major shortcoming. Everyone knows that it was Mr. Öcalan who brought this process to this stage. Although Mr. Öcalan does not place his own status ahead of the process, our people, and we demand recognition of his status.” Parlak also referred to the upcoming meeting of the National Security Council, saying that the final preparations would be made for the implementation of the framework law. He said, “It is extremely important that the meeting also produce an emphasis reflecting a will for democratization, particularly in terms of the National Security Council's approach to the Kurdish question from now on. Such an important emphasis could help establish a relationship of trust with the Kurds. It would have an impact on all Kurds living both in Turkey and abroad.”


Official applications will be accepted once all mechanisms are in place


Parlak said that the President must approve the decision after the National Security Council meeting and that it must then be published in the Official Gazette, after which the law will enter into force. He said efforts were continuing to prevent the process from being prolonged. Parlak …

title: FAU donates to the Zapatistas in Mexico
content:
The FAU decided at its federal congress in May 2026 to support the Zapatista movement with 10,000€ from its membership dues to help establish a hospital. The region has very poor healthcare infrastructure, which is why the Zapatistas, together with many others, are building a self-organized hospital for everyone. Since 1994, the Zapatistas in Chiapas, Mexico, have been organizing an autonomous way of life based on anti-capitalist, humanistic values, serving as a model for movements around the world. We feel closely connected to the Zapatista movement in its struggle and its ideals. Together, we fight for the livelihood of humanity and for just societies.

We are documenting our letter to the Zapatistas here:

this is the anarcho-syndicalist trade union federation FAU from Germany. We don’t know if you still remember us, among your many contacts. Last year, we had the privilege of being your guests at the Encuentro “Algunas Partes del Todo”, and our paths have crossed a few other times as well.

At our annual convention, we decided to contribute 10,000€ to your hospital, and we hope this will make your daily lives a little easier. This money does not come from the government, nor did we win it in the lottery, it comes from our membership dues, which all workers set aside from their wages every month to advance the struggle for a more just world.

But this money is only a reflection of something deeper: We see your movement, we have seen it for many years. It inspires us in our own movement. It inspires us to unlearn the things we were taught here - in the belly of the beast. And it inspires us - in a country not exactly known for its sense of humor - to laugh more as we go about serious daily tasks, take joy in the laughter of children, or to send a smile after a butterfly. Thank you for this gift, which keeps many of us going at least as well as your delicious coffee!

We know you always have more than enough to do back home, so we don’t want to take up more of your time with this letter. We just want to remind you once again that we’re organized internationally with similar organizations in the International Confederation of Labor (ICL), whose members mostly share similarly warm feelings toward you.

We are organized through the ICL in the following countries: the United Kingdom (IWW), France (CNT), Germany (FAU), Poland (OZZ IP), Greece (ESE), Italy (USI), Spain (CNT), Canada and the U.S. (IWW), Argentina (FORA), Brazil (FOB), Myanmar (FGWM), and Australia (IWW). We also have good friends in several other countries.

We share your concern for the future; we, too, see a great storm brewing, perhaps humanity’s greatest challenge. Until now, we have primarily organized with other unions, but many of us believe we need to broaden our perspective and reach out to others. We’re paying more attention to indigenous movements and to alliances like the Nyéléni Forum. But it is as you say: The main work is always right on our doorstep.

If you have any questions for us, or if our international contacts might be of some use to you, please feel free to reach out anytime. If you’d like to share your international contacts with us, we’d be happy to hear from you as well. As the ICL, we meet online every month to exchange ideas, in English or Spanish. If you’d ever like to join us as a guest to share information, ask questions, or exchange ideas — please let us know.

Stay cheerful, stay brave, stay healthy, Your comrades at the FAU
